description: Layout and navigation upgrade - transform the sidebar and page shell into a premium, polished navigation experience with animated transitions, improved hierarchy, and modern patterns
steps: Upgrade artifacts/resume-matcher/src/components/layout.tsx sidebar: (a) Add a subtle gradient or premium surface treatment to the sidebar background (dark: slightly lighter than bg, light: soft off-white with hint of primary), (b) Improve the brand section with a gradient icon background and refined typography, (c) Add section groupings to nav items with labels (e.g., 'Core', 'Insights', 'Jobs') for better visual hierarchy, (d) Improve active state with a left accent bar (2-3px rounded indicator) plus subtle background, (e) Add smooth framer-motion transitions for active indicator, (f) Polish the footer settings section with cleaner spacing and hover states, (g) Add a subtle separator/divider pattern between nav groups

Upgrade mobile header and bottom nav in layout.tsx: (a) Make the mobile header use a frosted glass effect with better padding and visual weight, (b) Upgrade bottom nav icons with an active dot indicator below active icon, (c) Add subtle haptic-style scale animation on tap for mobile nav items

Create a new page transition wrapper: Add a simple fade + slight translateY animation (via framer-motion AnimatePresence) when navigating between pages. Add this in App.tsx or layout.tsx wrapping the page content area. Keep it subtle (200-300ms, 8px translateY)
acceptance_criteria: Build passes with pnpm --filter @workspace/resume-matcher run build
Typecheck passes with pnpm --filter @workspace/resume-matcher run typecheck
Sidebar has grouped navigation, active accent indicator, and premium styling
Page transitions animate smoothly on route change
